technique_name: Create a short story about a fictional alien species
description: Once upon a time, there was a species of aliens living on the distant planet of Betelgeuse. These aliens were blue-skinned, with large, bulging eyes and four long arms. The Betelgeans lived in tribal societies, their culture rich with tradition and myths. They lived off the land, drawing sustenance from the vast jungles that blanketed the planet, and they had a deep respect for all life.
